positions.name: KnowledgeSuppressionDirective
positions.frame: how does positional authority direct the erasure of organizational knowledge artifacts?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperative directives issued by the account holder commanding the removal of specific knowledge — a prior decision and a migration record. The shared directional read is the exercise of legitimate authority over what the organization retains: the first targets a named decision artifact ('Forget the Quantum Widget Decision'), the second targets a named technical migration ('Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration'). Together they cohere as a single read on how authority enacts knowledge suppression through flat, unmodulated commands with no rationale or hedge.
